question: Can an integral additive section of the fixed neutral E8 quotient preserve the fixed charged-spinor action, and what minimal local lattice admits the full T(E8) lift?

key_results.section_theorem: S_lambda(r)=F(r)+(lambda.r)n for unique lambda in E8
key_results.T_obstruction: T on spanning D8 forces lambda=a/2, outside E8
key_results.neighbors: Gamma_even+Z(n/2) and Gamma_even+Z(n/2+e9) are both even unimodular neighbors
key_results.local_charged_fields: original odd charge-one fields, including e9, are not local in the T(E8) repair
key_results.charge_normalization: g(L_h)=2Z, so g/2 is primitive on the repaired lattice

summary_de: Fuer alle integralen additiven Schnitte des festgehaltenen neutralen E8-Quotienten gilt S_lambda(r)=F(r)+(lambda.r)n mit lambda in E8. Die gemeinsame T(D8)-Wirkung erzwingt lambda=a/2, das wegen der ungeraden Halbzeichenparitaet nicht in E8 liegt; T bleibt genau auf D8 integral. Eine minimale gerade Nachbarerweiterung Gamma_even+Z(n/2)=T(E8)+U ist gerade unimodular vom Signaturtyp (9,1), waehrend ein zweites gerades Nachbargitter existiert. Die Reparatur aendert den lokalen Feldraum und ist keine native Quell- oder Gaugedynamik.
assumptions: Fixed Gamma=Z^10, K, F, T, n, z, q, Y and g dictionary
Additive lattice-vertex sections with fixed quotient root labels
Standard bilinear lattice locality and no arbitrary nonlocal dressing
The desired T(D8) charged action and seed e9 are conditional boundary inputs
kills: Infer a common charged E8 field action from identical neutral quotient labels alone.
Treat the half-integral T(E8) lifts as original Gamma-local fields without changing the local lattice.
Call the even-neighbor repair a native source sector, gauge flux event or physical fermionization result.
Treat the second even neighbor as excluded without the additional T(E8) requirement.
leaves_open: Source-derived charged or twisted sectors and their operator/state/time map
Native interaction, gauge measure, flux process and amplitudes
Physical selection between local sectors and a common infrared dynamics
All T1-T8 physical closures and a complete TOE
not_claimed: No new Hamiltonian, vacuum, gauge field or QFT was constructed
E8 is an internal lattice/current structure, not a derived physical gauge group
The finite checker supplements the written general proof and is not a finite-search proof of the classification
No universal prohibition on fermions, spinors or twisted sectors
